integrity: The all-modulus formula is proved analytically by reducing to the frequency difference, stratifying by its generated cyclic quotient, maximizing over the unit group, and evaluating the resulting absolute cosine sum. The included finite checker is corroborative only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to idempotents with exactly two distinct frequencies and to finite-group \(L^1\) point concentration. It does not determine the unrestricted finite concentration constant or the open unrestricted asymptotic exponent.
title: Exact two-frequency \(L^1\) concentration on every cyclic group
